verses.original: קְֽרָא־ נָ֭א הֲיֵ֣שׁ עוֹנֶ֑ךָּ וְאֶל־ מִ֖י מִקְּדֹשִׁ֣ים תִּפְנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qə·rā- nā hă·yêš ‘ō·w·ne·kā wə·’el- mî miq·qə·ḏō·šîm tip̄·neh
verses.literal: Call out if you please vvv but who will answer To which of the holy ones will you turn

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כָּ֑עַשׂ יַהֲרָג־ לֶֽ֭אֱוִיל קִנְאָֽה׃ תָּמִ֥ית וּ֝פֹתֶ֗ה
verses.transliteration: kî- kā·‘aś ya·hă·rāḡ- le·’ĕ·wîl qin·’āh tā·mîṯ ū·p̄ō·ṯeh
verses.literal: For resentment kills a fool and envy slays the simple

verses.original: אֲ‍ֽנִי־ רָ֭אִיתִי אֱוִ֣יל מַשְׁרִ֑ישׁ פִתְאֹֽם׃ נָוֵ֣הוּ וָאֶקּ֖וֹב
verses.transliteration: ’ănî- rā·’î·ṯî ’ĕ·wîl maš·rîš p̄iṯ·’ōm nā·wê·hū wā·’eq·qō·wḇ
verses.literal: I have seen a fool taking root but suddenly his house was cursed

verses.original: בָנָ֣יו יִרְחֲק֣וּ מִיֶּ֑שַׁע וְיִֽדַּכְּא֥וּ בַ֝שַּׁ֗עַר וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: ḇā·nāw yir·ḥă·qū mî·ye·ša‘ wə·yid·dak·kə·’ū ḇaš·ša·‘ar wə·’ên maṣ·ṣîl
verses.literal: His sons are far from safety crushed in court without a defender

verses.original: רָ֘עֵ֤ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֹאכֵ֗ל וְאֶֽל־ קְצִיר֨וֹ׀ יִקָּחֵ֑הוּ מִצִּנִּ֥ים צַמִּ֣ים וְשָׁאַ֖ף חֵילָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: rā·‘êḇ ’ă·šer yō·ḵêl wə·’el- qə·ṣî·rōw yiq·qā·ḥê·hū miṣ·ṣin·nîm ṣam·mîm wə·šā·’ap̄ ḥê·lām
verses.literal: The hungry - consume . . . his harvest taking it even from the thorns and the thirsty pant after his wealth

verses.original: כִּ֤י׀ אָ֑וֶן לֹא־ יֵצֵ֣א מֵעָפָ֣ר עָמָֽל׃ לֹא־ יִצְמַ֥ח וּ֝מֵאֲדָמָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: kî ’ā·wen lō- yê·ṣê mê·‘ā·p̄ār ‘ā·māl lō- yiṣ·maḥ ū·mê·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: For distress does not spring from the dust and trouble does not sprout from the ground

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אָ֭דָם יוּלָּ֑ד לְעָמָ֣ל וּבְנֵי־ רֶ֝֗שֶׁף עֽוּף׃ יַגְבִּ֥יהוּ
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ā·ḏām yūl·lāḏ lə·‘ā·māl ū·ḇə·nê- re·šep̄ ‘ūp̄ yaḡ·bî·hū
verses.literal: Yet man is born to trouble as surely as sparks . . . fly upward

verses.original: אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶדְרֹ֣שׁ אֶל־ אֵ֑ל אָשִׂ֥ים דִּבְרָתִֽי׃ וְאֶל־ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: ’ū·lām ’ă·nî ’eḏ·rōš ’el- ’êl ’ā·śîm diḇ·rā·ṯî wə·’el- ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: However if I were you I would appeal to God and lay my cause before Him

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֣ה גְ֭דֹלוֹת וְאֵ֣ין חֵ֑קֶר נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת עַד־ אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·śeh ḡə·ḏō·lō·wṯ wə·’ên ḥê·qer nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ ‘aḏ- ’ên mis·pār
verses.literal: [the One] who does great and unsearchable things wonders . . . without number

verses.original: הַנֹּתֵ֣ן מָ֭טָר עַל־ פְּנֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ וְשֹׁ֥לֵֽחַ מַ֝יִם עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י חוּצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: han·nō·ṯên mā·ṭār ‘al- pə·nê- ’ā·reṣ wə·šō·lê·aḥ ma·yim ‘al- pə·nê ḥū·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: He gives rain to . . . the earth and sends water upon . . . the fields

verses.original: לָשׂ֣וּם שְׁפָלִ֣ים לְמָר֑וֹם וְ֝קֹדְרִ֗ים שָׂ֣גְבוּ יֶֽשַׁע׃
verses.transliteration: lā·śūm šə·p̄ā·lîm lə·mā·rō·wm wə·qō·ḏə·rîm śā·ḡə·ḇū ye·ša‘
verses.literal: He sets the lowly on high so that mourners are lifted to safety

verses.original: מֵ֭פֵר מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת עֲרוּמִ֑ים יְ֝דֵיהֶ֗ם תַעֲשֶׂ֥ינָה וְֽלֹא־ תּוּשִׁיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mê·p̄êr maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ ‘ă·rū·mîm yə·ḏê·hem ṯa·‘ă·śe·nāh wə·lō- tū·šî·yāh
verses.literal: He thwarts the schemes of the crafty so that their hands find no success

verses.original: לֹכֵ֣ד חֲכָמִ֣ים בְּעָרְמָ֑ם נִמְהָֽרָה׃ וַעֲצַ֖ת נִפְתָּלִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: lō·ḵêḏ ḥă·ḵā·mîm bə·‘ā·rə·mām nim·hā·rāh wa·‘ă·ṣaṯ nip̄·tā·lîm
verses.literal: He catches the wise in their craftiness and sweeps away the plans of the cunning

verses.original: יְפַגְּשׁוּ־ חֹ֑שֶׁךְ יוֹמָ֥ם יְֽמַשְׁשׁ֥וּ בַֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃ וְ֝כַלַּ֗יְלָה
verses.transliteration: yə·p̄ag·gə·šū- ḥō·šeḵ yō·w·mām yə·maš·šū ḇaṣ·ṣā·ho·rā·yim wə·ḵal·lay·lāh
verses.literal: They encounter darkness by day and grope at noon as in the night

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣שַׁע אֶבְיֽוֹן׃ מֵ֭חֶרֶב מִפִּיהֶ֑ם וּמִיַּ֖ד חָזָ֣ק
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ša‘ ’eḇ·yō·wn mê·ḥe·reḇ mip·pî·hem ū·mî·yaḏ ḥā·zāq
verses.literal: He saves the needy from the sword in their mouth and from the clutches of the powerful

verses.original: לַדַּ֣ל וַתְּהִ֣י תִּקְוָ֑ה וְ֝עֹלָ֗תָה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: lad·dal wat·tə·hî tiq·wāh wə·‘ō·lā·ṯāh qā·p̄ə·ṣāh pî·hā
verses.literal: So the poor have hope and injustice shuts its mouth

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הִנֵּ֤ה אֱ֭נוֹשׁ אֱל֑וֹהַּ יוֹכִחֶ֣נּֽוּ אַל־ תִּמְאָֽס׃ וּמוּסַ֥ר שַׁ֝דַּ֗י
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê hin·nêh ’ĕ·nō·wōš ’ĕ·lō·w·ah yō·w·ḵi·ḥen·nū ’al- tim·’ās ū·mū·sar šad·dai
verses.literal: Blessed indeed is the man [whom] God corrects so do not despise the discipline of the Almighty

verses.original: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַכְאִ֣יב וְיֶחְבָּ֑שׁ יִ֝מְחַ֗ץ וְיָדוֹ תִּרְפֶּֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: kî hū yaḵ·’îḇ wə·yeḥ·bāš yim·ḥaṣ wə·yå̄·ḏō tir·pe·nāh
verses.literal: For He wounds but He also binds He strikes but His hands also heal

verses.original: יַצִּילֶ֑ךָּ בְּשֵׁ֣שׁ צָ֭רוֹת לֹא־ רָֽע׃ יִגַּ֖ע בְּךָ֣ וּבְשֶׁ֓בַע׀
verses.transliteration: yaṣ·ṣî·le·kā bə·šêš ṣā·rō·wṯ lō- rā‘ yig·ga‘ bə·ḵā ū·ḇə·še·ḇa‘
verses.literal: He will rescue you from six calamities no harm will touch you in seven

verses.original: בְּ֭רָעָב פָּֽדְךָ֣ מִמָּ֑וֶת וּ֝בְמִלְחָמָ֗ה מִ֣ידֵי חָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rā·‘āḇ pā·ḏə·ḵā mim·mā·weṯ ū·ḇə·mil·ḥā·māh mî·ḏê ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: In famine He will redeem you from death and in battle from the stroke of the sword

verses.original: תֵּחָבֵ֑א בְּשׁ֣וֹט לָ֭שׁוֹן וְֽלֹא־ תִירָ֥א מִ֝שֹּׁ֗ד כִּ֣י יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: tê·ḥā·ḇê bə·šō·wṭ lā·šō·wn wə·lō- ṯî·rā miš·šōḏ kî yā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue and will not fear havoc when it comes

verses.original: תִּשְׂחָ֑ק לְשֹׁ֣ד וּלְכָפָ֣ן אַל־ תִּירָֽא׃ וּֽמֵחַיַּ֥ת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ
verses.transliteration: tiś·ḥāq lə·šōḏ ū·lə·ḵā·p̄ān ’al- tî·rā ū·mê·ḥay·yaṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: You will laugh at destruction and famine and need not fear the beasts of the earth

verses.original: כִּ֤י בְרִיתֶ֑ךָ עִם־ אַבְנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֣ה הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה וְחַיַּ֥ת הָשְׁלְמָה־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḇə·rî·ṯe·ḵā ‘im- ’aḇ·nê haś·śā·ḏeh haś·śā·ḏeh wə·ḥay·yaṯ hā·šə·lə·māh- lāḵ
verses.literal: For you will have a covenant with the stones of the field and the wild animals will be at peace with you

verses.original: וְֽ֭יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־ אָהֳלֶ֑ךָ שָׁל֣וֹם וְלֹ֣א תֶחֱטָֽא׃ וּֽפָקַדְתָּ֥ נָ֝וְךָ
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî- ’ā·ho·le·ḵā šā·lō·wm wə·lō ṯe·ḥĕ·ṭā ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tā nā·wə·ḵā
verses.literal: You will know that your tent is secure and find nothing amiss when inspecting your home

verses.original: וְֽ֭יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־ זַרְעֶ֑ךָ רַ֣ב וְ֝צֶאֱצָאֶ֗יךָ כְּעֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî- zar·‘e·ḵā raḇ wə·ṣe·’ĕ·ṣā·’e·ḵā kə·‘ê·śeḇ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: You will know that your offspring will be many your descendants like the grass of the earth

verses.original: תָּב֣וֹא אֱלֵי־ קָ֑בֶר בְכֶ֣לַח גָּדִ֣ישׁ כַּעֲל֖וֹת בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: tā·ḇō·w ’ĕ·lê- qā·ḇer ḇə·ḵe·laḥ gā·ḏîš ka·‘ă·lō·wṯ bə·‘it·tōw
verses.literal: You will come to the grave in full vigor like a sheaf of grain gathered in season

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ חֲקַרְנ֥וּהָ זֹ֭את הִ֑יא כֶּֽן־ שְׁ֝מָעֶ֗נָּה וְאַתָּ֥ה דַֽע־ לָֽךְ׃פ
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- ḥă·qar·nū·hā zōṯ hî ken- šə·mā·ʿen·nāh wə·’at·tāh ḏa‘- lāḵ
verses.literal: Indeed we have investigated . . . and it is true So hear it and know for yourself
